facts.fact: Starlink is on sale in Kenya; per the Communications Authority's Q1 2025 report it lost over 2,000 subscribers, more than 10% of its base, in the quarter.
Starlink briefly suspended new urban signups in Kenya, notably Nairobi, in late 2024 because of congestion; signups restarted in June 2025.

note: No absolute regulator subscriber count given, so no counted fact.
